title: Title & Registration Services Policy Manual, Clauses on the Buyer's Registration Documents
content:
**4.1 Readiness.** A Title & Registration Services order becomes ready to submit only when every document in the service type's required documents has been received in acceptable form. Receipt and acceptability are read from the order's own document entries in the system (document type, form and the date printed on the document), never from the customer's account of them.

**4.2 Status.** A document is received only on an order whose status is awaiting documents, ready to submit or rejected.

**4.3 Form.** A document listed among the service type's wet-ink documents counts only as a wet-ink original; a document listed among the scan-accepted documents may arrive as a scan or photo; every other document may be e-signed or a wet-ink original.

**4.4 Content.**
(a) A proof of residence counts only when its statement date is no more than the service type's maximum age before the date it was received, and its address is the registration address.
(b) A proof of insurance counts only when it shows the purchased VIN.
(c) An odometer disclosure is not required for a vehicle at or above the exempt model age.
(d) A signed power of attorney for a registration state in the notarized list counts only when notarized.
(e) A prior plate registration counts only when the plate is registered to the buyer.

**4.5 Return period.** The customer is asked to return all documents within the customer document due days after opening. Returning them later does not stop the order, but changes who bears late penalties under Kestrel's reimbursement terms for late-registration penalties.

**4.6 Inspection.** For Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection, the VIN inspection form and the emissions certificate (the emissions certificate only for addresses in emissions counties) must be obtained within the inspection due days after handover.

**4.7 Statement of mailing.** A customer's statement that a document was mailed is not receipt.

**4.8 Copies set aside by a rejection.** A document received before the order's most recent state rejection that names it no longer counts toward the required documents.

The required documents, the wet-ink and scan-accepted lists, the maximum age, the exempt model age, the notarized-state list and the return and inspection periods are the figures of the order's service type.

## Clause 4.4(a) at its boundary (hypothetical dates, 60-day maximum age)

| Statement date | Date received | Days between | Counts |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 April | 60 | yes, provided the address is the registration address |
| 28 February (non-leap year) | 30 April | 61 | no |

## Readiness checklist read from clause 4.1

| Every required document received | Each in an acceptable form and passing its content test | Order ready to submit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |
| yes | no, at least one fails | no |
| no | not reached | no |

## Points of judgement

- A customer who says the power of attorney is "in the mail" has not supplied it; only a document entry on the order counts.
- A proof of insurance showing a VIN other than the purchased VIN does not count, whatever its form.
